title: Silent Streets
author: Mitra Samal
text:
I have always loved
the silent streets of my small town.
The young evening with the sun
setting at one corner
and the moon peeking on the other.
The wind hums a sweet song,
gently caressing the quaint houses
with their dodging moods.
A man noiselessly strolls
with a string bag upon his shoulder,
Children merrily hop back home
with their soft giggles filling the street,
Women murmur the evening prayers,
Faint ringing of bells
spread in the atmosphere,
adding to the rhythm.
The near quietness is a safe haven,
undisputed and serene.
As though it were an enchanted
fairyland,
blessed with mountains
glimmering in the moonlight
and whispering trees,
where hope still dances in the air.
